name: Feinschliff
description: German for 'the final polish'. A quality-of-life collection for Minecraft Alpha: HUD information, window and performance options, camera and flight, inventory comfort, a tool for every block, and a handful of things this version left half-finished. It adds no blocks, items or entities, writes no new NBT, and leaves every hill, cave and dungeon where the seed puts it, so a world stays playable in unmodified vanilla after the mod is removed.
